verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Workflows can automate decisions and reduce manual review time, implying some cases still route to human review, but there is no evidence describing a dedicated review queue UI showing document images, extracted fields, and check results, or how reviewer decisions are written back into the inquiry record. missing for 10: description of the manual review queue interface, evidence of document/field/check display in review, and confirmation that reviewer decisions update the verification record.
